mini_game_capsule.note: Reserved; keep the top-right of the background clear.

phone.note: UI, not in the background art. Lies on the floor to the right of the toolbox.

lao_qian_button.note: UI, not in the background art. Directly above the phone.

layer_order: (ui_toolbox_dividers only if the body skin has an empty interior)
UI: HUD, phone, 老钱 button, tool labels

layers.name: bg_bathroom_base
layers.notes: Full-screen opaque background, 390x780 @2x (780x1560). No toilet, bucket, tray, phone, ads, portraits or coins. Top-right y=0-44 kept clear for the mini-game capsule; wall under the coin capsule (right, y=48-140) is clean cream tile. Wall/floor junction near y=300. Top/bottom 15px have no interactive points.

layers.name: toilet_tank
layers.notes: Tank against the back wall. Draw under the lid and flush button. The tank top is blank so the flush-button sprite can be overlaid at (195, 240).

layers.name: toilet_flushbtn_idle
layers.notes: Idle flush button. Hit area should be at least 44x44 even if the art is smaller.

layers.name: toilet_flushbtn_pressed
layers.notes: Pressed state of the flush button, same anchor as idle.

layers.name: toilet_lid_up
layers.notes: Lid raised, leaning on the tank. Draw above the tank, under the 王阿姨 seat cover when that layer is on.

layers.name: toilet_bowl
layers.notes: Bowl, lowered seat ring and pedestal. The inner opening is transparent so water / clogs / the waterline show through. Opening sits at about y=390-578, centered at x=195.

layers.name: toilet_bowl_inner
layers.notes: Inner porcelain well, same pixel size and placement as toilet_bowl. Draw immediately under the water / waterline, above the bowl rim. Fills the transparent opening so the floor does not show through. The drain is the darker ellipse toward the bottom of the well.

layers.name: water_surface_full
layers.notes: Full-water fill of the bowl opening, same pixel size and anchor as toilet_bowl. Covers the opening to the inner rim. Draw above the inner porcelain and waterline.

layers.name: water_surface_normal
layers.notes: Scalable normal-water oval, smaller and slightly lower in the bowl so a ring of porcelain and the waterline mark stay visible above it.

layers.name: water_ripple_ring
layers.notes: Optional ripple ring, sits just inside the full-water rim. Can be rotated / pulsed.

layers.name: water_drop
layers.notes: Single droplet particle. Spawn near the rim for full-water overflow and for splash bursts. Anchor is the drop center.

layers.name: water_splash
layers.notes: Short splash burst for pressing a full bowl. Place at the inner rim / water surface.

layers.name: water_waterline_mark
layers.notes: Thin beige-grey stain ring on the inner porcelain, same size and anchor as toilet_bowl. Visible in the normal-water state as the high-water reference; hide or draw under the water in the full state.

layers.name: clog_paper
layers.notes: Paper clog wad. Place in the center of the water (both full and normal states).

layers.name: clog_duck
layers.notes: Yellow rubber duck (order 3, after it is identified / pulled). Do not show in the character portrait or on 李姐.

layers.name: clog_duck_silhouette
layers.notes: Underwater silhouette of the same duck pose. Use while the duck is still hidden in the bowl; the headlamp upgrade can tint / brighten this layer.

layers.name: scene_bucket_empty
layers.notes: Interactive dump bucket, empty. Sit on the floor to the right of the toilet, above the phone / 老钱 button, in front of the washing machine.

layers.name: scene_bucket_water
layers.notes: Same bucket, filled with water. Swap with the empty layer when the player has scooped water into it. Same anchor.

layers.name: home_wang_seatcover
layers.notes: 王阿姨 home layer: pink-and-cream crochet cover, sits on the raised lid.

layers.name: home_wang_windowsill
layers.notes: 王阿姨 home layer: pothos, soap dish and 花露水 on a short sill. Place on the left mint wall, below the speech-bubble band, not in the HUD. No pickle jars, no ads.

layers.name: home_wang_washboard
layers.notes: 王阿姨 home layer: wooden washboard, lower right, leaning by the washing machine. Kept out of the coin / ⚙ wall.

layers.name: ui_toolbox_lid_lv1
layers.notes: Lv1 lid (short strip, tipped back). Upgrade skins replace this file. Toolbox box is 290x130 at left 12 / bottom 18.

layers.name: ui_toolbox_body_lv1
layers.notes: Lv1 body with worn-wood lining, thin walls, clean front band for labels, faded sticker on the left end. This lv1 body already includes the three wood partitions; do not also stack ui_toolbox_dividers on top of it or they will double. Future empty bodies can use the dividers layer.

layers.name: ui_toolbox_dividers
layers.notes: Three thin wood partitions at the fixed slot positions, same size and placement as ui_toolbox_body_lv1. The lv1 body already includes partitions; do not stack this layer on top of it. Use with future empty-interior skins.

layers.name: ui_toolbox_lockplate
layers.notes: Wood plate + brass padlock. Reuse on locked slots. Default copies: slot 3 at (191.5, 695.2) and slot 4 at (260.5, 695.2), center anchor. The label「升级解锁」is UI text, not painted in the art.

layers.name: tool_plunger_old
layers.notes: Old red-cup plunger with yellow tape on the wooden handle. Default tool in slot 1. Selected state (lift 8px + gold outline) is done in code.

layers.name: tool_plunger_pro
layers.notes: Upgraded plunger: blue cup, black grip, metal ferrule. Swap in for tool_plunger_old at the same anchor.

layers.name: tool_scoop
layers.notes: Blue plastic water scoop. Default tool in slot 2.

layers.name: tool_snake
layers.notes: Hand-crank spring drain snake (grey closed drum, red crank, visible coiled cable). Unlock into slot 3 (or 4) after upgrade; until then the lockplate covers that slot.
